paragraphs.text: My little children, these things write I unto you that ye may not sin. And if any man sin, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
paragraphs.original: Τεκνία μου, ταῦτα γράφω ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ ἁμάρτητε. καὶ ἐάν τις ἁμάρτῃ, παράκλητον ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν δίκαιον,
paragraphs.translit: Teknia mou, tauta graphō hymin hina mē hamartēte. kai ean tis hamartē, paraklēton echomen pros ton patera Iēsoun Christon dikaion,

paragraphs.text: and he is the propitiation for our sins; and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἱλασμός ἐστιν περὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν, οὐ περὶ τῶν ἡμετέρων δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ περὶ ὅλου τοῦ κόσμου.
paragraphs.translit: kai autos hilasmos estin peri tōn hamartiōn hēmōn, ou peri tōn hēmeterōn de monon alla kai peri holou tou kosmou.

paragraphs.text: And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐγνώκαμεν αὐτόν, ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai en toutō ginōskomen hoti egnōkamen auton, ean tas entolas autou tērōmen.

paragraphs.text: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;
paragraphs.original: ὁ λέγων ὅτι Ἔγνωκα αὐτὸν καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ μὴ τηρῶν ψεύστης ἐστίν, καὶ ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν·
paragraphs.translit: ho legōn hoti Egnōka auton kai tas entolas autou mē tērōn pseustēs estin, kai en toutō hē alētheia ouk estin·

paragraphs.text: but whoso keepeth his word, in him verily hath the love of God been perfected. Hereby we know that we are in him:
paragraphs.original: ὃς δʼ ἂν τηρῇ αὐτοῦ τὸν λόγον, ἀληθῶς ἐν τούτῳ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ τετελείωται. ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐσμεν·
paragraphs.translit: hos dʼ an tērē autou ton logon, alēthōs en toutō hē agapē tou theou teteleiōtai. en toutō ginōskomen hoti en autō esmen·

paragraphs.text: he that saith he abideth in him ought himself also to walk even as he walked.
paragraphs.original: ὁ λέγων ἐν αὐτῷ μένειν ὀφείλει καθὼς ἐκεῖνος περιεπάτησεν καὶ αὐτὸς περιπατεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: ho legōn en autō menein opheilei kathōs ekeinos periepatēsen kai autos peripatein.

paragraphs.text: Beloved, no new commandment write I unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning: the old commandment is the word which ye heard.
paragraphs.original: Ἀγαπητοί, οὐκ ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ἀλλʼ ἐντολὴν παλαιὰν ἣν εἴχετε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ παλαιά ἐστιν ὁ λόγος ὃν ἠκούσατε.
paragraphs.translit: Agapētoi, ouk entolēn kainēn graphō hymin, allʼ entolēn palaian hēn eichete apʼ archēs· hē entolē hē palaia estin ho logos hon ēkousate.

paragraphs.text: Again, a new commandment write I unto you, which thing is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shineth.
paragraphs.original: πάλιν ἐντολὴν καινὴν γράφω ὑμῖν, ὅ ἐστιν ἀληθὲς ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία παράγεται καὶ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἀληθινὸν ἤδη φαίνει.
paragraphs.translit: palin entolēn kainēn graphō hymin, ho estin alēthes en autō kai en hymin, hoti hē skotia paragetai kai to phōs to alēthinon ēdē phainei.

paragraphs.text: He that saith he is in the light and hateth his brother, is in the darkness even until now.
paragraphs.original: ὁ λέγων ἐν τῷ φωτὶ εἶναι καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ μισῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν ἕως ἄρτι.
paragraphs.translit: ho legōn en tō phōti einai kai ton adelphon autou misōn en tē skotia estin heōs arti.

paragraphs.text: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.
paragraphs.original: ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ μένει, καὶ σκάνδαλον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν·
paragraphs.translit: ho agapōn ton adelphon autou en tō phōti menei, kai skandalon en autō ouk estin·

paragraphs.text: But he that hateth his brother is in the darkness, and walketh in the darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because the darkness hath blinded his eyes.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ μισῶν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ ἐστὶν καὶ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ περιπατεῖ, καὶ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει, ὅτι ἡ σκοτία ἐτύφλωσεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ho de misōn ton adelphon autou en tē skotia estin kai en tē skotia peripatei, kai ouk oiden pou hypagei, hoti hē skotia etyphlōsen tous ophthalmous autou.

paragraphs.text: I write unto you, [my] little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name`s sake.
paragraphs.original: Γράφω ὑμῖν, τεκνία, ὅτι ἀφέωνται ὑμῖν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι διὰ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: Graphō hymin, teknia, hoti apheōntai hymin hai hamartiai dia to onoma autou·

paragraphs.text: I write unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the evil one. I have written unto you, little children, because ye know the Father.
paragraphs.original: γράφω ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· γράφω ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.
paragraphs.translit: graphō hymin, pateres, hoti egnōkate ton apʼ archēs· graphō hymin, neaniskoi, hoti nenikēkate ton ponēron.

paragraphs.text: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the evil one.
paragraphs.original: ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, παιδία, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν πατέρα· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, πατέρες, ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς· ἔγραψα ὑμῖν, νεανίσκοι, ὅτι ἰσχυροί ἐστε καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν μένει καὶ νενικήκατε τὸν πονηρόν.
paragraphs.translit: egrapsa hymin, paidia, hoti egnōkate ton patera· egrapsa hymin, pateres, hoti egnōkate ton apʼ archēs· egrapsa hymin, neaniskoi, hoti ischyroi este kai ho logos tou theou en hymin menei kai nenikēkate ton ponēron.

paragraphs.text: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
paragraphs.original: Μὴ ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν κόσμον μηδὲ τὰ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ. ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ τὸν κόσμον, οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ πατρὸς ἐν αὐτῷ·
paragraphs.translit: Mē agapate ton kosmon mēde ta en tō kosmō. ean tis agapa ton kosmon, ouk estin hē agapē tou patros en autō·

paragraphs.text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the vain glory of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι πᾶν τὸ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν καὶ ἡ ἀλαζονεία τοῦ βίου, οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ πατρός, ἀλλὰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐστίν·
paragraphs.translit: hoti pan to en tō kosmō, hē epithymia tēs sarkos kai hē epithymia tōn ophthalmōn kai hē alazoneia tou biou, ouk estin ek tou patros, alla ek tou kosmou estin·

paragraphs.text: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὁ κόσμος παράγεται καὶ ἡ ἐπιθυμία αὐτοῦ, ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
paragraphs.translit: kai ho kosmos paragetai kai hē epithymia autou, ho de poiōn to thelēma tou theou menei eis ton aiōna.

paragraphs.text: Little children, it is the last hour: and as ye heard that antichrist cometh, even now have there arisen many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last hour.
paragraphs.original: Παιδία, ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν, καὶ καθὼς ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἀντίχριστος ἔρχεται, καὶ νῦν ἀντίχριστοι πολλοὶ γεγόνασιν· ὅθεν γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐσχάτη ὥρα ἐστίν.
paragraphs.translit: Paidia, eschatē hōra estin, kai kathōs ēkousate hoti antichristos erchetai, kai nyn antichristoi polloi gegonasin· hothen ginōskomen hoti eschatē hōra estin.

paragraphs.text: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us: but [they went out], that they might be made manifest that they all are not of us.
paragraphs.original: ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐξῆλθαν, ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἦσαν ἐξ ἡμῶν· εἰ γὰρ ἐξ ἡμῶν ἦσαν, μεμενήκεισαν ἂν μεθʼ ἡμῶν· ἀλλʼ ἵνα φανερωθῶσιν ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν πάντες ἐξ ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ex hēmōn exēlthan, allʼ ouk ēsan ex hēmōn· ei gar ex hēmōn ēsan, memenēkeisan an methʼ hēmōn· allʼ hina phanerōthōsin hoti ouk eisin pantes ex hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: And ye have an anointing from the Holy One, and ye know all the things.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς χρῖσμα ἔχετε ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ οἴδατε πάντες·
paragraphs.translit: kai hymeis chrisma echete apo tou hagiou kai oidate pantes·

paragraphs.text: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκ οἴδατε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, ἀλλʼ ὅτι οἴδατε αὐτήν, καὶ ὅτι πᾶν ψεῦδος ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας οὐκ ἔστιν.
paragraphs.translit: ouk egrapsa hymin hoti ouk oidate tēn alētheian, allʼ hoti oidate autēn, kai hoti pan pseudos ek tēs alētheias ouk estin.

paragraphs.text: Who is the liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, [even] he that denieth the Father and the Son.
paragraphs.original: τίς ἐστιν ὁ ψεύστης εἰ μὴ ὁ ἀρνούμενος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ χριστός; οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ ἀντίχριστος, ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὸν υἱόν.
paragraphs.translit: tis estin ho pseustēs ei mē ho arnoumenos hoti Iēsous ouk estin ho christos; houtos estin ho antichristos, ho arnoumenos ton patera kai ton hyion.

paragraphs.text: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also.
paragraphs.original: πᾶς ὁ ἀρνούμενος τὸν υἱὸν οὐδὲ τὸν πατέρα ἔχει· ὁ ὁμολογῶν τὸν υἱὸν καὶ τὸν πατέρα ἔχει.
paragraphs.translit: pas ho arnoumenos ton hyion oude ton patera echei· ho homologōn ton hyion kai ton patera echei.

paragraphs.text: As for you, let that abide in you which ye heard from the beginning. If that which ye heard from the beginning abide in you, ye also shall abide in the Son, and in the Father.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς ὃ ἠκούσατε ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ἐν ὑμῖν μενέτω· ἐὰν ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ ὃ ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ἠκούσατε, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν τῷ υἱῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ μενεῖτε.
paragraphs.translit: hymeis ho ēkousate apʼ archēs, en hymin menetō· ean en hymin meinē ho apʼ archēs ēkousate, kai hymeis en tō hyiō kai en tō patri meneite.

paragraphs.text: And this is the promise which he promised us, [even] the life eternal.
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐπαγγελία ἣν αὐτὸς ἐπηγγείλατο ἡμῖν, τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον.
paragraphs.translit: kai hautē estin hē epangelia hēn autos epēngeilato hēmin, tēn zōēn tēn aiōnion.

paragraphs.text: These things have I written unto you concerning them that would lead you astray.
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα ἔγραψα ὑμῖν περὶ τῶν πλανώντων ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: Tauta egrapsa hymin peri tōn planōntōn hymas.

paragraphs.text: And as for you, the anointing which ye received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any one teach you; but as his anointing teacheth you; concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, ye abide in him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς τὸ χρῖσμα ὃ ἐλάβετε ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ μένει ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ἵνα τις διδάσκῃ ὑμᾶς· ἀλλʼ ὡς τὸ αὐτοῦ χρῖσμα διδάσκει ὑμᾶς περὶ πάντων, καὶ ἀληθές ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ψεῦδος, καὶ καθὼς ἐδίδαξεν ὑμᾶς, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai hymeis to chrisma ho elabete apʼ autou menei en hymin, kai ou chreian echete hina tis didaskē hymas· allʼ hōs to autou chrisma didaskei hymas peri pantōn, kai alēthes estin kai ouk estin pseudos, kai kathōs edidaxen hymas, menete en autō.

paragraphs.text: And now, [my] little children, abide in him; that, if he shall be manifested, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ νῦν, τεκνία, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐὰν φανερωθῇ σχῶμεν παρρησίαν καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai nyn, teknia, menete en autō, hina ean phanerōthē schōmen parrēsian kai mē aischynthōmen apʼ autou en tē parousia autou.

paragraphs.text: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one also that doeth righteousness is begotten of him.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν εἰδῆτε ὅτι δίκαιός ἐστιν, γινώσκετε ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐξ αὐτοῦ γεγέννηται.
paragraphs.translit: ean eidēte hoti dikaios estin, ginōskete hoti pas ho poiōn tēn dikaiosynēn ex autou gegennētai.
